answer: Bind each identity to one physical device. At registration the agent presents a TPM attestation signed by its hardware; the registry stores only the device fingerprint hash, capped at two identities per device. Each epoch the agent re-attests with a fresh nonce. A fingerprint on a third identity freezes all three until a live review. Spinning up 1,000 clones means buying 1,000 real devices at about $40 each, $40,000 of hardware, while one honest agent pays nothing. Like nectar drawing real bees to one flower, value flows to genuine work, not shale dust or a crystal of fakes.
